note: Municipality-reported damage from the UNDP-supported survey of 135 affected areas across 19 districts and 8 governorates, 5-15 December 2024. These are preliminary municipal reports collected in ten days on local knowledge - not engineering assessments - and they are not additive with satellite estimates or with any 2026 figure.

districts.name: Baabda
districts.note: The Dahieh belt: the largest single concentration, with roughly two thirds reported completely damaged.

caveats: Municipal declaration, not engineering assessment: the survey traded technical rigour for speed, and produced the response's fastest national damage assessments.
Named districts account for 57,199 of the 59,577 reported housing units; the remainder is spread across the other surveyed districts.
Not additive with satellite-based estimates, which use different methods, scopes and cut-offs.
